toc.title: Python training for intermediate learners
toc.overview: This one-day training focuses on validating CSV invoice data using Python, with an emphasis on detecting and handling duplicate invoices. Finance analysts will learn to process CSV files, validate rows, and generate accepted and rejected files with clear rejection reasons. The training is designed for intermediate Python users familiar with lists and dictionaries.
